bbox_reference.interpretation: dynamic bbox crop can validate but may cost around 50k before task-specific shrinking

lowering_blocks.purpose: Find nonzero bbox and crop/align the task020 5x5 local frame.
lowering_blocks.expected_cost_risk: medium-high; exp046 small bbox crop cost was 50589 for task031
lowering_blocks.implementation_note: Reuse exp046 style dynamic bbox crop first; later replace with task020-specific 10x10/bbox5 shortcuts.

lowering_blocks.purpose: For each nonzero color, compute group counts in corners, edge_mid, inner, center over the 5x5 frame.
lowering_blocks.expected_cost_risk: medium if done for all 9 colors; low if target color can be inferred cheaply
lowering_blocks.reject_pattern: MatMul signature over examples, per-example color table
lowering_blocks.implementation_note: Rule must stay color-role based. Do not use absolute target-color table.

lowering_blocks.purpose: Implement exp062 decision rule: corners_eq1 -> corners, edge_mid_eq1 -> edge_mid, has_inner -> inner_diag, else corners.
lowering_blocks.implementation_note: This is the core nonlookup rule and should remain tiny.

lowering_blocks.purpose: Select the unique D4 variant compatible with current target-color positions and fill exactly the three missing cells.
lowering_blocks.expected_cost_risk: medium; could explode if implemented separately for all colors/classes/variants
lowering_blocks.reject_pattern: large ScatterND coordinate table, MatMul over variants
lowering_blocks.implementation_note: Start with explicit masks for 3 template classes x D4 variants, then prune with compatibility.

lowering_blocks.purpose: Map 5x5 local fill mask back to 30x30 one-hot output.
lowering_blocks.preferred_ops: Pad/Gather or Where on full 30x30 tensor
lowering_blocks.expected_cost_risk: medium-high; full-grid Where may dominate memory
lowering_blocks.implementation_note: First implementation can use full-grid Where for correctness; cost pass will likely need sparse writeback.

decision: Implement correctness-first ONNX next, then optimize bbox/writeback. Do not use raw 24-case table or teacher artifact.
